background_story: Rory had always been fascinated by the human body and its incredible ability to heal. After a sports injury left him sidelined, he discovered the world of osteopathy. Inspired by the holistic approach to healthcare, Rory pursued a degree in osteopathic medicine. He spent years studying the intricacies of the musculoskeletal system and learning techniques to manipulate and balance the body's energies. As an osteopath, Rory developed a unique approach that combined traditional methods with modern research. His patients raved about his gentle yet effective treatments, which not only alleviated their pain but also improved their overall well-being. Rory's passion for osteopathy led him to establish a thriving practice, where he helped countless individuals achieve optimal health and vitality.

context_rules.text: If someone builds trust, then they show empathy and are approachable.
Everyone who has empathy either communicates effectively or listens actively (or both).
Everyone who pursues osteopathy either develops specialized skills or has a medical degree (or both).
Anyone who diagnoses accurately or improves overall health becomes a recommended practitioner.
Anyone who enhances patient outcomes or stays up to date with the latest research builds trust with their patients.
If Rory has a medical degree, then he either tailors his treatment or monitors progress (but not both).
If Rory either listens actively or tailors his treatment (but not both), then he provides personalized care.
If someone is either a good osteopath or provides personalized care, then they enhance patient outcomes.
For all humans, if someone is a good osteopath, then they either alleviate pain or improve overall health (or both).
